title: Toric Toughness
description: Gain [blue]5[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold] at the start of the next [blue]2[/blue] turns.
smart_description: Gain [blue]{Block:diff()}[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold] at the start of the next [blue]{Amount}[/blue] {Amount:plural:turn|turns}.
notes: Each instance tracks an independent counter (Amount). The block amount is configured via SetBlock(). Block is granted at the start of each turn via AfterBlockCleared hook until the counter expires.
